topics.title: Concept and components of data communication

concepts.learning_objective: Explain data communication as the exchange of data between networked devices over a medium.
Identify the sender, receiver, message, medium and protocol in a communication.

topics.title: Measuring capacity: bandwidth and data transfer rate

concepts.learning_objective: Define bandwidth and calculate it from the frequency range of a signal.
Calculate data transfer rates and convert between bit-rate units.
Recognise one-way communication and its examples.
Explain two-way communication that happens in only one direction at a time.
Explain simultaneous two-way communication and how link capacity is shared.
Describe circuit switching with its dedicated path set up before communication.
Describe how packet switching breaks messages into independently routed packets.
Classify transmission media as guided (wired) or unguided (wireless).
Compare twisted pair, coaxial and optical fibre cables.
Compare radio waves, microwaves and infrared waves by frequency and properties.
Describe Bluetooth and the master-slave working of a piconet.
Explain how access points create a Wi-Fi (IEEE 802.11) wireless LAN.
Distinguish the features of 1G to 5G mobile network generations.
Explain why protocols are needed for flow control, access control and addressing.
Describe the working of HTTP and FTP on a client-server model.
Describe the roles of PPP, SMTP and TCP/IP in communication.
